Hi!
If you're going to remix this, please remember to change something in the project, and give proper credit in the notes and credits of the project. This collection of animations really mean a lot to me, and it upsets me to see that people are using them to break the Scratch guidelines when they remix without changing anything. Changing the watermark doesn't count. By changing the watermark, you're basically stealing everything inside the project.
Thank you for understanding!
